ruleDefinitions.name: Arbitrary File Download Via Squirrel.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the usage of the "Squirrel.exe" to download arbitrary files. This binary is part of multiple Electron based software installations (Slack, Teams, Discord, etc.)

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\squirrel\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\update\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-download\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-update\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-updateRollback\\=.*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*http.*"))
